Pilot · India

Smit Machchhar

flydubai Flight 10732026Developing story
Flight
flydubai Flight 1073
Date
30 September 2026
Aircraft
Boeing 737 MAX 8
Location
Tabuk, Saudi Arabia

flydubai Flight 1073 on 30 September 2026 is still under investigation, so details of what Smit Machchhar did may change as more is confirmed.

Captain Smit Machchhar was flying flydubai Flight 1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv when he was attacked in the cockpit by the first officer and the aircraft went into a rapid descent. The UAE Attorney-General has since said the first officer, who used the cockpit crash axe, attempted to carry out a terrorist act. Though seriously injured, Machchhar opened the cockpit door, allowing passengers and crew to restrain the attacker. Off-duty pilots travelling on board took over and the Boeing 737 MAX 8 landed safely at Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, with all 174 passengers alive. A resolution introduced in the US House of Representatives honours him and the crew and passengers. Gujarat has announced its Vishisht Gujarat Garima Award and ₹25 lakh for him, and Mankind Pharma ₹1 crore for him and his family. The investigation is ongoing.

Timeline

  1. 30 September 2026flydubai Flight FZ1073 leaves Dubai for Tel Aviv, a Boeing 737 MAX 8 with 174 passengers, captained by Smit Machchhar. Sources: 1 2
  2. 30 September 2026The first officer attacks him in the cockpit with the crash axe and the jet plunges about 16,000 feet in under a minute. Badly wounded, Machchhar opens the cockpit door and passengers and crew rush in to restrain the attacker. Sources: 1 2 3
  3. 30 September 2026Off-duty flydubai pilots travelling on board take the controls and land at Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. Everyone on board survives. Sources: 1 2
  4. 1 October 2026He is flown from Saudi Arabia to the UAE for treatment. The UAE Attorney-General orders an investigation, including any link to terrorism. Sources: 1 2 3
  5. 1 October 2026Gujarat announces the Vishisht Gujarat Garima Award and a ₹25 lakh reward for him. Sources: 1 2
  6. 2 October 2026Prime Minister Narendra Modi speaks to him by video call in hospital. Mankind Pharma announces ₹1 crore for him and his family. Sources: 1 2 3
  7. 3 October 2026The UAE Attorney-General says the first officer attempted to carry out a terrorist act. Sources: 1 2
  8. 5 October 2026Two Israeli officials say the first officer told interrogators he planned the attack before joining flydubai. A resolution honouring Machchhar and the crew and passengers is introduced in the US House of Representatives. Sources: 1 2 3
  9. 8 October 2026Israel's President Isaac Herzog says Machchhar will receive Israel's Presidential Award for Civilian Heroism once he recovers, as he presents the Presidential Medal for Civilian Heroism to six passengers from the flight. Sources: 1 2

Who helped

  • Tali Manes PassengerWaiting outside the front toilet for her 6-year-old daughter, she heard the struggle in the cockpit and raised the alarm.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5
  • Tzvika Manes PassengerRushed from the front row, got into the cockpit and helped overpower the attacker, tying him up with headphone cables.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5
  • Yaniv Hayun PassengerGot into the cockpit, helped pull the attacker away from the controls, then pulled back on the controls to help level the plane until a pilot took over.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Asaf Rajuan PassengerGot into the cockpit and helped overpower the attacker.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Dr Shota Musayev Passenger (dentist)Helped tie up the attacker, then treated the badly wounded captain, stopping his bleeding.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Two off-duty flydubai pilots Off-duty crewTravelling as passengers to fly the return leg, they took over the controls and landed the plane safely at Tabuk. They have not been officially named.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5
  • David Kimotho Lead flight attendant (purser)With John Muchina, gave the wounded captain first aid on the cabin floor and kept order, telling passengers to sit down.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • John Muchina Cabin crewGave the wounded captain first aid alongside Kimotho, checking that he was conscious and helping keep the cabin calm.Sources: 1 2 3 4

Questions people ask

Who is Captain Smit Machchhar?

An Indian airline pilot who has flown the Boeing 737 for flydubai as a captain since 2022. Before that he spent about 11 years at SpiceJet in India. He has around 9,750 flying hours. Sources: 1 2 3

What happened on flydubai Flight FZ1073?

On 30 September 2026, on the way from Dubai to Tel Aviv, the first officer attacked Captain Machchhar with the cockpit crash axe and the plane went into a steep dive. Though badly hurt, he opened the cockpit door so passengers and crew could stop the attacker. Off-duty flydubai pilots landed the plane at Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, and all 174 passengers survived. Sources: 1 2 3

Who else helped save the flight?

Passengers Tzvika Manes, Yaniv Hayun, Asaf Rajuan and Dr Shota Musayev overpowered the first officer, and Musayev treated the captain's wounds. Tali Manes raised the alarm. Kenyan flight attendants David Kimotho and John Muchina gave him first aid, and off-duty flydubai pilots landed the plane. Sources: 1 2 3

How is Captain Machchhar now?

He is being treated in hospital in the UAE. India's ambassador said on 1 October that he was "speaking, smiling and laughing", and on 6 October India's embassy said he "continues to make steady progress and is regaining his health". On 9 October reports said he was still recovering in hospital in Abu Dhabi. Sources: 1 2 3 4

How has he been honoured?

Gujarat announced its Vishisht Gujarat Garima Award and ₹25 lakh, Mankind Pharma ₹1 crore, and a resolution honouring him was introduced in the US House of Representatives. On 8 October Israel's President Isaac Herzog announced that he will receive Israel's Presidential Award for Civilian Heroism. Prime Minister Modi spoke to him by video call. Reports say he may be considered for the Ashoka Chakra, but nothing has been announced. Sources: 1 2 3 4 5

How do you spell his name?

Smit Machchhar. It is sometimes written Machchar or Machhar.

Is this Smit Machchhar's official website?

No. AirSkyHero is an independent site about heroes of the sky. It is not run by or connected to Captain Machchhar, his family or flydubai.
